# GlobaLeads22

> GlobaLeads22 is a B2B lead generation SaaS for freelancers, consultants, and small agencies. It searches Google Maps and public company websites to find businesses by type and location, extracts contact information (emails, WhatsApp, LinkedIn), scores leads with AI, and generates personalised outreach angles. No subscription — pay once for a credit pack.

## What GlobaLeads22 Does

Search for businesses by keyword and location (e.g. "dental clinics in Miami", "law firms in Berlin", "solar installers in Austin"). The tool queries Google Maps and the web, then scrapes each company's website to extract publicly listed contact information. An AI system then scores each lead and writes a personalised outreach hook based on the business's weaknesses and the user's service type.

### Core features

- Google Maps search by business type and city/region
- Website scraping for emails, WhatsApp links, and LinkedIn profiles
- AI lead scoring (0–100 opportunity score per lead)
- AI-generated outreach hooks and pitch angles personalised to your service
- Filter and sort leads by contact availability, score, or name
- Export to styled Excel (.xlsx)
- Search history saved per account

## Who Uses GlobaLeads22

Freelancers and small agencies doing outbound sales who need a fast way to build targeted lead lists without manual research. Common use cases: web designers finding businesses with weak websites, marketing agencies finding local companies without active social media, SEO consultants finding businesses with poor search presence, virtual assistants finding small companies that need help.

## Pricing

One-time credit packs. No subscription. Credits do not expire.

- Free tier: 30 credits (sign up, no card required)
- Starter: $9 for 100 credits — 10 searches
- Growth: $19 for 300 credits — 30 searches
- Pro: $39 for 700 credits — 70 searches

Credit costs: 1 search = 10 credits. Unlocking AI Intelligence on a lead = 1 credit.

## How It Compares

Unlike Apollo.io or Hunter.io, GlobaLeads22 focuses on local and regional business discovery via Google Maps — useful for finding small businesses that are not in CRM databases. Unlike LinkedIn Sales Navigator, it finds businesses across all industries, not just those with LinkedIn presence. Unlike manual Google searches, it automates the extraction of contact details and scores each lead.

## Technical Details

- Data sources: Google Maps API (business discovery), Firecrawl (website scraping), Anthropic Claude Haiku (lead scoring and pitch generation)
- Contact data extracted is publicly available on business websites
- No personal data sold. GDPR compliant.
- Data deletion available: support@globaleads22.com
